title: Settings
signInAgain: {{detail}}. Reload and sign in. If a NAS move just failed, copy library.db back to the default folder before Create admin.

language.label: Language
language.help: Saved to your account, so it follows you to other devices.

appDir.label: App folder
appDir.help: Config, session key, SQLite, and packaged Python stay here. This is not the photo library. On a packaged Mac install it is /Library/Application Support/mosaicWave. Local debug uses /Library/Application Support/mosaicWave-dev.

current.label: Current library
current.help: Photos and thumbnails in use now. SQLite stays in the App folder above.

move.label: Move library
move.needsMaintenance: Moving the library needs maintenance mode, so nobody else is using it while it is copied.
move.needsMaintenanceDraining: Maintenance mode is waiting for the running job to finish. Moving needs it to be on.
move.help: One destination: a local folder, or an SMB share. Photos and thumbnails move only when you click Save folder. SQLite stays in the App folder. Returning to the app folder replaces leftover library files there; config and login stay. If the move fails, mosaicWave keeps the original folder.
move.lockedQnap: This QPKG keeps the library in a hidden .mosaicWave folder on the volume (not inside the app folder). Remove and reinstall does not delete it.
move.lockedEnv: MOSAICWAVE_DATA_DIR is set on this process, so the folder is read-only here.

dest.label: Destination
dest.help: Always under /Volumes. Mount point is the volume name only. Folder is the same library path as SMB (rest after the share). Leave mount point blank for mosaicWave-…. Last dest is shown above, not typed back in. Do not pick Finder Public.

nas.userHelp: QNAP account for this share, not the mosaicWave login. Do not put user@ in the host box. Password is required on first Save folder. Names starting with a dot are reserved on QNAP shares.

save.confirmHome: Move the library back to the app folder? Leftover library files there are replaced. Config and login stay. Browse and typing do not move anything until you confirm here.
save.confirmMove: Move the library database, photos, and thumbnails to this destination? Browse and typing do not move anything until you confirm here.
save.restarting: Restarting the API to open the new library folder…
save.unreachableDebug: Could not reach the API (Save folder may still be mounting). Wait and retry, or restart with sudo sh scripts/start.sh.
save.unreachable: Could not reach the API (Save folder may still be mounting). Wait and retry — it should restart on its own.
save.noRestartDebug: API did not come back after Save folder. Run sudo sh scripts/start.sh.
save.noRestart: API did not come back after Save folder. It should restart on its own — wait and retry.

users.qnap: People sign in with their QNAP account. mosaicWave does not add NAS users here.

thumbnails.label: Thumbnails
thumbnails.help: Create small previews for photos that do not have one yet, for example after an import or a restore. Progress also shows in Activity.

server.title: Server
server.intro: Options for the whole server: where the app and the library are stored, and who can sign in. Your own options (language, thumbnails, backing up your library) are in Settings.
